notes:
Nexus 2.3.1: the orb gets George, plus an optional Microsoft voice

- New default orb voice: George, a calm British man. It's free, has no limit and works offline on your PC. Nexus downloads it once by itself (about 155 MB); until then the orb uses the Windows voice.
- Optional: Microsoft's cloud voices (Ryan and 13 more) with your own free Microsoft Azure key, which gives 0.5 million characters a month for free. Paste it in Settings > Assistant > Microsoft Azure key and press Save & test.
- If Azure can't be reached or the free amount runs out, the orb switches to George, then the Windows voice.
- Removed the 2.2 online voice: Microsoft locked it, which is why you heard the old Windows voice.
